title: Recruitment of Fpt1 to tRNA genes requires TFIIIB and the N-terminal TPR array of TFIIIC subunit τ131
authors: van Breugel ME; Seifert-Davila W; Bakker MJ; Meeussen JVW; Hoogvliet IA; Cardona MN; van Welsem T; Ammerlaan D; Baudin F; Celie P; Lenstra TL; Müller CW; van Leeuwen F
one_liner_zh: 该文研究酵母中Fpt1向tRNA基因的招募机制，涉及TFIIIB/TFIIIC与蛋白互作，但核心是转录因子与染色质因子招募，非TF-DNA结合建模，且无AI或物理模拟方法。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

Transfer-RNA genes (tDNAs) in budding yeast recruit varying amounts of Fpt1, a regulator of RNA polymerase III (RNAPIII) occupancy. Fpt1 occupancy resembles that of the general transcription factor TFIIIC but how Fpt1 is recruited to tDNAs remains unclear. Here we show that both TFIIIB and TFIIIC are required for Fpt1 binding under active as well as repressive RNAPIII conditions. Depletion of TFIIIB reduced Fpt1 occupancy without affecting TFIIIC. In contrast, TFIIIC depletion led to reduced Fpt1 and a gene-specific reduction in TFIIIB occupancy. Moreover, upon depletion of TFIIIC, Fpt1 and TFIIIB were lost to different extents. We identified the C-terminal intrinsically disordered region of Fpt1 as critical for increased Fpt1 binding under repressive conditions. Within this region, a short α-helix was predicted to interact with the N-terminal tetratricopeptide repeat array of the TFIIIC subunit τ131, a region also known to interact with TFIIIB. Deletion of this α-helix abrogated stress-induced Fpt1 recruitment to tDNAs, as did mutations in the predicted interaction surface of τ131, while having a milder effect on TFIIIB occupancy. Together, these findings uncovered a dual and dynamic mechanism of Fpt1 recruitment to tDNAs with independent contributions of TFIIIB and TFIIIC.
abstract_zh:
摘要

在芽殖酵母中，转移RNA基因（tDNAs）招募不同量的Fpt1，这是一种RNA聚合酶III（RNAPIII）占据的调控因子。Fpt1的占据情况类似于通用转录因子TFIIIC，但Fpt1如何被招募至tDNAs仍不清楚。在此，我们显示在活跃及抑制性RNAPIII条件下，TFIIIB和TFIIIC均为Fpt1结合所必需。TFIIIB的耗竭减少了Fpt1的占据，而不影响TFIIIC。相反，TFIIIC的耗竭导致Fpt1减少，并引起TFIIIB占据的基因特异性降低。此外，在TFIIIC耗竭后，Fpt1和TFIIIB的丢失程度不同。我们鉴定出Fpt1的C端内在无序区域在抑制条件下对增加Fpt1结合至关重要。在该区域内，预测一个短α-螺旋与TFIIIC亚基τ131的N端四肽重复阵列相互作用，该区域也已知与TFIIIB相互作用。删除此α-螺旋消除了应激诱导的Fpt1向tDNAs的招募，τ131预测相互作用表面的突变也产生相同效果，而对TFIIIB占据的影响较轻。综合这些发现，揭示了Fpt1向tDNAs招募的双重动态机制，其中TFIIIB和TFIIIC各自独立贡献。
